details: @clickwraps/fetch@99.9.1 is a dependency-confusion staging stub. The published tarball contains no functional code — package/index.js is an empty `module.exports = {}` and package.json declares no lifecycle scripts and no bin — but it declares its sole dependency as a raw off-registry tarball: "ltidisafe": "hxxps://ltidi[.]storage[.]googleapis[.]com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4[.]0[.]7[.]tgz". Installing the package therefore causes npm to download and unpack a tarball hosted on Google Cloud Storage (bucket ltidi, path /depenconf/) that never went through registry review. The remote artifact name, ltidisafe-4.0.7.tgz, plus the "depenconf" path indicate a dependency-confusion attempt against an internal package named ltidisafe. The off-registry dependency and the sentinel version 99.9.1 are the only behaviour in the package; no code from the remote tarball is included here. IOC: hxxps://ltidi[.]storage.googleapis[.]com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4.0.7.tgz

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
